plain: The default graphite primary fill is now near-black in light mode and near-white in dark mode, so primary Buttons, active Tags and accent fills read stronger; re-take accent screenshots.

steps.plain: The accent fill (surface.accent, accent.rest) is graphite.950 #19161a in light (was #4a4146) and graphite.50 #f5f4f4 in dark (was #cbc6c9); on-accent text is 17.9:1 and 13.8:1.
In dark mode the accent hover and pressed fills now step darker from the near-white rest (pressed is graphite.200 #cbc6c9, was graphite.50).
